Callout.Name: Suspected Still
Callout.Message: Suspected illegal distillery in the hills.
Callout.Advisory: Copper tubing and drums seen from the road.

Script.Line: Tubing, drums and a fire under it. Copper tubing.
It is a proper setup up there. It has been going a while.
There is a smell carries down the valley at night.

Lines.Approach: Tubing, drums and a fire going. Somebody has been at this a while.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
